2._section_summary: This discussion section presents the findings of a single study that investigated the relationships between body image (body appreciation and body dissatisfaction) and subjective happiness in two samples of Western women. The results indicate that body appreciation is a strong positive predictor of subjective happiness, and that body appreciation is influenced by age and BMI. The section also highlights the ubiquity of weight-based dissatisfaction and discusses the limitations of the online, self-selecting survey, including the cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported data.
